title: Genesis Steering: Better Activation Steering Through Training Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.19114v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Activation steering controls large language models at inference time, but its effectiveness depends on the choice of reference data. We introduce genesis steering, which derives a genesis vector from contrastive examples in the model's own fine-tuning data. When these data are unavailable, we draw on the membership inference literature to identify likely training examples and construct a proxy dataset. We establish two theoretical results on optimal displacement to the decision boundary and reduced proxy-estimation bias. We evaluate genesis steering and membership-based proxy construction on T\"ulu-3-8B, whose fine-tuning data are publicly available, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct as a control. We find that safety data from T\"ulu-3-8B's training mixture yield stronger steering than external datasets on both models. translated_title: Genesis Steering：借助训练数据实现更好的激活引导
translated_abstract: 激活引导技术可在推理阶段对大语言模型进行控制，但其有效性取决于参考数据的选择。我们提出Genesis Steering方法，从模型自身微调数据中的对比样本推导出“创生向量”。当这些数据不可用时，我们借助成员推断领域的方法识别可能的训练样本并构建代理数据集。我们在理论上建立了两个结果：关于到决策边界的最优位移，以及代理估计偏差的降低。我们在Tülu-3-8B（其微调数据公开可得）上评估了Genesis Steering和基于成员推断的代理构建方法，并以Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct作为对照。研究发现，来自Tülu-3-8B训练数据混合中的安全数据在两个模型上都比外部数据集产生更强的引导效果。在Tülu-3-8B上，各成员推断得分在识别训练样本方面基本一致，且由排名靠前的样本构建的引导向量能够取得……
tldr: 提出Genesis Steering方法，利用模型自身微调数据（或通过成员推断构建的代理数据）生成激活引导向量，并从理论和实验上证明基于训练数据的引导比外部数据集更有效。
en_tdlr: Genesis Steering derives activation steering vectors from a model's own fine-tuning data (or membership-inference-based proxy data), with theoretical and empirical results showing that training-data-derived steering outperforms external datasets.
